summary: Comprehensive test suite spanning unit (matrix.bats), workflow structure (workflow.bats), and end-to-end pipeline (act.bats) validation. Covers all major requirements: cartesian products, include/exclude semantics with GitHub Actions overrides, strategy options, max-size boundaries, error cases, and stdin support. TDD methodology evident. Well-organized fixture-based tests with expected-value manifests and clear separation of concerns. Rigor is solid but could test more complex include/exclude interactions and input validation edge cases (special characters, numeric boundaries, very large structures). Dependencies on fixture files (basic.json, exclude.json, etc.), matrix.jq library, and workflow YAML are referenced correctly but not shown in provided code—assuming correct implementation, would catch most regressions effectively.
